title: Chapter 700 - 700 Advancement; Domain Lord!
content:
Chapter 700 - 700 Advancement; Domain Lord!

Chapter 700 - 700 Advancement; Domain Lord!

700 Advancement; Domain Lord!

Time flowed like water, and in the blink of an eye, a year had passed.

A delicate and cute little boy was staggering on the ground.

He was Lin Fan’s son, Lin Chengzhen.

His name meant that as long as it was his dream, it could come true.

This name undoubtedly showed how much Lin Fan, Hu Tian, and the others loved him.

Lin Xiaoyao bent down and picked Lin Chengzhen up. “Chengzhen, be good and call me ‘Aunt’!”

However, Lin Chengzhen only looked at Lin Xiaoyao quietly with his big black eyes, still not speaking.

“Aunt!” Lin Xiaoyao said tirelessly.

“Aunt…”

No matter how Lin Xiaoyao taught him, Lin Chengzhen never spoke.

“What’s going on?” Lin Xiaoyao murmured. “He can greet all the others but why can’t he call me ‘Aunt’?”

…

In the blink of an eye, another two years passed.

On this day, Lin Fan’s will flickered as he entered the River of Time once more.

After several years of research, he already knew how to find the laws and cultivation techniques of the River of Time.

Lin Fan walked on the death path for another 130 meters before he felt as though there was a huge mountain on his body. He could no longer move forward.

“Let me try the life path again!”

As soon as he finished speaking, he took a step to the side and quickly moved forward on the main road of the life system.

When he walked 112 meters, his footsteps began to slow down.

At this moment, a crisp and pleasant voice came from behind.

“Huh? A Planet-level cultivator actually came to the River of Time and grasped the laws of life!”

When Lin Fan heard that, he turned around.

He saw a woman whose face was covered in light behind him.

Even so, just based on her perfect figure and outstanding temperament, it was enough to judge that she was definitely a beauty. She was a super beauty!

“You don’t seem to have lived long!” the woman said. “To be exact, you should be younger than 5,000 years old. Not bad!”

After she finished speaking, she continued walking forward.

[Ding! Kathleen has a favorable impression of you. Favorability: One star.]

[Kathleen: Goddess of the Temple of Life. Cultivation: Unknown. Due to your innate talent in the Life Laws, she have a favorable impression of you. Current favorability is one star.]

Lin Fan muttered in his heart, ‘Another unknown cultivation state.’

He raised his head and looked ahead, only to find that Kathleen had already disappeared.

Lin Fan did not take it to heart as he continued walking forward along the life path.

When he reached 132 meters, Lin Fan felt like he could not take another step.

Hence, he switched to the fire-type path.

At this moment, another set of footsteps sounded behind him.

“It’s you again, you little fellow who’s too ambitious. Hmph!”

The man in red armor grunted and released a sea of fire that engulfed Lin Fan.

Lin Fan, who was lying on the bed in the Coiling Dragon Villa, opened his eyes suddenly.

“It’s the lord of the Fire God Palace again,” he said angrily.

After a while, Lin Fan finally calmed down.

He opened the attribute panel.

[Host: Lin Fan]

[Cultivation: Level-Nine Planet (9.9 billion/10 billion)

“Domain lord level, today!”

Lin Fan took out a few spirit crystals and placed them in specific positions around his body.

At the same time, Lin Fan continued to draw talismans in the void, giving off an extremely mysterious aura.

On the other hand, the spirit crystals emitted dense spiritual energy. Soon, the entire room was covered in a dense fog of spiritual energy.

The Spirit Gathering Formation was complete!

Over the past few years, Lin Fan had obtained the outline of formations from the system. Coupled with his long period of comprehension, he had already possessed an extraordinary ability to create formations.

“Suck!”

Lin Fan took in a deep breath. The surging spiritual energy surged into his body like a tidal wave.

Two days later, a vast and boundless aura spread out from Lin Fan. The terrifying pressure was like a tall mountain that floated up into the hearts of all the living beings on Earth.

Then, a golden light shot into the sky, forming a huge cloud tornado in the sky.

[Ding! Congratulations on reaching the Domain Lord level. You’ve obtained: Transcendence Golden Body, Saint Stone x1, Nine Heavens Black Robe x1.]

[Transcendence Golden Body: Possesses the same power as the main body. It can fuse with the main body and suddenly gain double the power. After the Transcendence Golden Body dissipates, it will take a day to reform.]

Merging into the main body and obtaining double the strength?

This was definitely a super cultivation technique that could help disguise himself as someone weaker to take down someone strong.

[Saint Stone: A mysterious stone that has the special power to change fate and give birth to powerful creatures.]

Change fate? It could make him lucky?

Nurturing creatures? Would something jump out of the stone?

[Nine Heavens Black Robe: An Emperor-grade robe. It has a defense that Emperor-grade experts cannot break through.]

Above the Universe level was the Emperor level!

Since even a King-level expert could not break through it, Lin Fan immediately felt a sense of security.

With a thought, a white stone, a long robe with a dragon emblem, and a man who looked exactly like Lin Fan appeared in front of him.

Lin Fan put on the Nine Heavens Black Robe and touched it gently.

Although it had a strong defense, it was still very soft and comfortable to the touch.

Lin Fan and the Transcendence Golden Body nodded at each other before Lin Fan walked out.

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Huang Ling, and the others were all standing at the door.

Lin Fan said, “Don’t worry. I just broke through.”

Hearing this, everyone heaved a sigh of relief and was filled with joy.

At this moment, Lin Fan felt something tugging at his pants.

He lowered his head and saw that it was his son, Lin Chengzhen.

“Daddy… Hug…”

Lin Fan bent down and hugged Lin Chengzhen in his arms. He smiled and said, “Let me see how heavy you’ve gotten now.

“Ah, you’re very heavy!

“But it’s not enough. You have to eat more.”

“Alright,” Lin Chengzhen said.

“Have you been obedient recently?” Lin Fan asked.

“Very obedient,” Lin Chengzhen said.

Not far away, a different voice sounded.

“Obedient? How is he obedient? He’s so rude. He doesn’t even call me ‘Aunt’!” Lin Xiaoyao said angrily.

Lin Chengzhen said timidly, “A-Aunt.”

When Lin Xiaoyao heard this, her face immediately bloomed like a flower.

“That’s a good boy!” she said happily.

“Wait for me. I’ll prepare something delicious and fun for you later!”

Lin Fan smiled. “Hurry up and thank Aunt.”

“Thank you, Aunt,” Lin Chengzhen said.

With the addition of a child, the atmosphere in the Coiling Dragon Villa became even more relaxed and blissful.

Qiu Ziqian could not help but touch her flat stomach that still carried a life inside.

“Ziqian, don’t worry,” Huang Ling comforted her. “You’ll definitely be like Hu Tian in the future. Your belly will get bigger soon, and you’ll give birth to a healthy and cute child.”

Qiu Ziqian nodded vigorously.
